correctness.rationale: For q=1 vector field has first integral H=xz−y²/2+x|x|y, preserved in both x signs. H=-h<0 meets x=0 only at y=±sqrt(2h), hence switching is transverse, no sliding and unique crossing flow; gradient H≠0, coordinate w=z+|x|y shows each leaf is cylinder R×S¹. Divergence of vector field equals −|x| sectorwise; at x=0 saltation S=I±4y e_z e_x^T, determinant one and dH invariant. This gives exact coarea-area decay without surface delta. Surface divergence theorem on disk/annulus bounded by cycles yields 0=−∫|x|ω<0, proving at most one cycle; existence from Llibre–Novaes–Valls 2023 Theorem 1 yields exactly one. Periodic derivative μ=exp(−∫|x|dt) strictly in (0,1); two unit Floquet multipliers from time and first integral. Weighted scaling (a x(at),a² y(at),a³ z(at)) maps h→a^4 h and invariant integral μ; bounded omega-limit on cylinder with no equilibria tends to unique cycle by crossing-flow Poincaré–Bendixson. Independent SymPy recomputed sector conserved H, divergence, saltation det and vector mapping; global existence not proved computationally.
